title: Good Boy Supply Co. — Bristol
mocks: Fictional shop/address, inventory counts, product claims, durability story and reviews. Original cut-out-style dog SVG and CSS pet/product/bath illustrations. Four-product filtered/searchable shelf and query-linked product dialogs; empty categories honestly disclose missing catalogue. Local self-wash price selection and delivery/loyalty details. No cart, stock, checkout, actual delivery, loyalty rewards or booking.
